oneOf.description: Creates records.
Provides attributes for other blueprints to include.

version.description: Component manifest versions are non-negative 32-bit protocol values.

code.description: Stable job identifier, unique within the blueprint.

context.description: Context code that receives imported values. Required for imports.

enabled.description: Whether the job is scheduled. Defaults to `true`.

extension_id.description: Installed extension that provides the connector operation.

input.description: Operation input table passed to the extension.

input_file_id.description: Uploaded file supplied to an import.

interval_seconds.description: Run interval in seconds, from 60 to 2592000 (30 days).

operation_id.description: Connector operation declared by the extension.

Enforcement.description:
Synchronous enforcement of an error-severity rule. Enforcing rules reject
violating writes with `422 rule_violation` instead of only reporting findings.

on_save.description: Reject every write that leaves the record violating the rule.

transitions.description: Reject the listed status transitions while the rule is violated.

ExtensionOutletLayout.description:
Host-owned per-blueprint extension layout. It is declarative data only;
contribution keys cannot select DOM nodes or invoke extension code.

hidden.description: Contribution keys hidden in this outlet.

code.description: Code of the included mixin blueprint.

field.description: Relationship attribute on the source blueprint.

source_blueprint.description: Blueprint whose records reference this record.

Predicate.description:
A requirement on one record. A predicate *holds* when the data is
acceptable; a rule reports a finding, a check rejects a save and a
transition condition blocks a transition when it does not hold.

Comparisons with a missing operand hold: combine them with `required`
when a value must exist.

oneOf.description: The attribute has a value. Relationships need at least one target.
The attribute's current value changed within the age limit. Rules only.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum value age in seconds, from 1 to 31536000 (one year).

oneOf.description: The record has the system tag.
The record does not have the system tag.

Compares an attribute with another attribute or a literal value. Set
exactly one of `other_attribute_code`, `subject_attribute_code`
(inside `linked` or `referenced_by` only) and `value`.

other_attribute_code.description: Another attribute of the same record.

subject_attribute_code.description: An attribute of the record being checked, when comparing from a linked record.

value.description: A literal string, number or boolean. Write dates as `"2026-01-31"` strings.

oneOf.description: The attribute's value is one of the listed values, such as status codes.
Compares a date or datetime attribute with now plus `offset_days`.

offset_days.description: Days added to the current time; negative values look back.

oneOf.description: No other live record of the blueprint revision has the same values. Rules only.
Checks the records linked through a relationship attribute (one hop).

predicate.description: Evaluated on each linked record. Cannot follow further links.

oneOf.description:
Counts records of another blueprint whose relationship targets this
record and that match the optional predicate. Set `min`, `max` or both.
Following the relationship from this record never returns to it. Rules only.
Every nested predicate holds.
At least one nested predicate holds.

retain_on_edit_roles.description: Workspace roles whose edits keep records published on their channels.

Quantifier.description: How many linked records must satisfy a `linked` predicate.

oneOf.description: Every linked record satisfies the predicate. Holds with no links.
At least one linked record satisfies the predicate.
No linked record satisfies the predicate.

RawAttributeDeclaration.description: An attribute declared by the blueprint or selected from an include.

acyclic.description:
Reject relationship writes that would form a cycle through this
self-referencing attribute. Requires `context_editable = "default"`.

allowed_extensions.description: Accepted file extensions without the leading dot.

code.description: Attribute identifier, unique within the blueprint.

context_editable.description: Contexts that accept writes: `all`, or only the `default` context.

context_fallback.description:
Missing values in a non-default context: `default` inherits from the
nearest ancestor context; `none` leaves the attribute absent.

default_value.description:
Value stored in the default context when a record is created.
Not supported for relationships and files.

description.description:
What the attribute holds, for people and agents. Attributes selected
with `from` use the mixin's description and cannot set their own.
`{{…}}` references resolve from the workspace lexicon.

extension_configuration.description: JSON configuration passed to the extension type.

extension_type.description:
A `provider:type@semver-range` reference resolved by the host using an
enabled workspace installation.

from.description:
Selects `<include alias>.<attribute code>` from an include. The
attribute code must match `code`.

image_only.description: Accept only images and generate thumbnails.

name.description:
Human-readable label shown in forms, filters, and table headers.
Defaults to the humanized `code`. Attributes selected with `from` use
the mixin's name and cannot set their own. `{{…}}` references resolve
from the workspace lexicon.

ordered.description: Whether multiple files keep their order. Defaults to `true` for `many`.

readonly.description: Preview-only in the Catalog web app. API writes remain allowed.

tags.description:
Free-form metadata. `hidden`, `hidden:form`, `hidden:detail`,
`hidden:explorer`, and `hidden:metadata` hide the attribute from default UI.

target_blueprint.description: Blueprint that relationship targets must use.

target_blueprints.description:
Several blueprints that relationship targets may use. Cannot be
combined with `target_blueprint`.

target_cardinality.description: How many sources may link to one target. Defaults to `many`.

tree.description:
An acyclic hierarchy in which every record has at most one target
(parent). Implies `acyclic` and `cardinality = "one"`.

value_schema.description: JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) source for scalar values.

oneOf.description: Evaluated only when run on demand.
Evaluated on a UTC cron schedule.

cron.description: Six-field cron expression, including seconds: `sec min hour day month weekday`.

timezone.description: Schedule time zone. Only `UTC` is supported.

oneOf.description: Evaluated when a record event occurs.

event_type.description: Record event that evaluates the rule.

oneOf.description: Evaluated after an import finishes.

Severity.description: How prominently findings from this rule are reported.

field.description: A local scalar field or up to three relationship hops ending in a scalar field.

label.description:
Column heading. Defaults to the attribute name. `{{…}}` references
resolve from the workspace lexicon.

TransitionSelector.description:
A status change that the rule guards. The predicate is evaluated on the
state the transition would produce.

from.description: Source status code. Omit to guard every change into `to`.

UniqueKeyDefinition.description:
A business key: no two records of the blueprint family may share the
normalized values of these attributes.

attributes.description:
One to eight scalar attributes, or single-target relationships, whose
combined values must be unique.

case_sensitive.description:
Compare strings exactly. By default strings are compared after
trimming, collapsing whitespace, and lowercasing.

code.description: Stable key identifier, unique within the blueprint.

scope.description:
`workspace` (default) compares default-context values; `context`
compares resolved values separately in every context.

ViewDefinition.description:
A named view. `dropdown_option` labels relationship choices, `table`
configures Explorer columns, and layout roots arrange `detail` and `edit`.

oneOf.description: Label shown for the record in relationship dropdowns.

separator.description: Text between label fields. Defaults to ` · `.

oneOf.description: Explorer table columns.

columns.description: Table columns. Cannot be combined with `fields`.

component.description: Registered component that renders this block.

fields.description: Legacy scalar-field shorthand. New definitions use `columns`.

oneOf.description: Blocks stacked vertically.

component.description: Registered component that renders this block.

oneOf.description: Blocks arranged in a responsive grid.

component.description: Registered component that renders this block.

tabs.description: Tabs, each with a label and its own blocks.

oneOf.description: Blocks split into collapsible sections.

component.description: Registered component that renders this block.

sections.description: Collapsible sections, each with a label and its own blocks.

oneOf.description: A versioned layout override for record-owned extension surfaces.

outlets.description:
Layouts keyed by record outlet: `record_preview_panel`,
`record_attribute_decoration`, or `record_action`.

version.description: Layout format version. Only `1` is supported.

ViewNode.description:
A view block. Containers hold `children`, `tabs`, or `sections`; leaves
render attributes or static content.

component.description: Registered component that renders this block.

component.description: Registered component that renders this block.

sections.description: Collapsible sections, each with a label and its own blocks.

oneOf.description: A static heading.

oneOf.description: Static text.

component.description: Registered component that renders this block.

oneOf.description: A horizontal divider.

component.description: Registered component that renders this block.

oneOf.description: A scalar attribute's value or input.

component.description: Registered component that renders this block.

oneOf.description: A relationship attribute's linked records.

component.description: Registered component that renders this block.

oneOf.description: Records that reference this record, opened in a paginated dialog.

component.description: Registered component that renders this block.

label.description:
Button and dialog label. `{{…}}` references resolve from the
workspace lexicon.

relationships.description: Source blueprint relationship fields that point at this record.

label.description: Section heading. `{{…}}` references resolve from the workspace lexicon.
Tab label. `{{…}}` references resolve from the workspace lexicon.

description: An Attricat blueprint: a versioned record type or an includable mixin.

attributes.description:
Attributes in display order. Each declares exactly one of `value_type`,
`extension_type`, or `from`.

code.description: Stable blueprint identifier, using ASCII letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.

connector_jobs.description: Scheduled extension imports and exports. Record blueprints only.

description.description:
What the blueprint's records are, for people and agents, such as
"Product groupings, such as Basic tools". `{{…}}` references resolve
from the workspace lexicon.

extensions.description:
Namespaced extension metadata is preserved in the immutable source
definition and intentionally ignored by the core blueprint compiler.

format_version.description: Definition format version. Only `1` is supported.

includes.description: Exact, version-pinned mixins whose attributes can be selected with `from`.

name.description:
Human-readable blueprint name. `{{…}}` references resolve from the
workspace lexicon.

publication.description: Channel publication behavior when records are edited.

record_schema.description:
JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) source for cross-field record validation.
Record blueprints only.

rules.description: Data-health rules evaluated for this blueprint's records.

items.description: A data-health rule that reports findings for records matching its predicate.

code.description: Stable rule identifier, unique within its owner.

enforcement.description:
Reject violating saves or status transitions. Requires `error` or
`critical` severity and a predicate that is safe for synchronous evaluation.

triggers.description: One to eight events that evaluate the rule.

unique_keys.description:
Business keys whose normalized values must be unique across the
blueprint family. Record blueprints only.

views.description:
Named views: `dropdown_option`, `table`, `detail`, and `extension_layout`.
The `detail` layout also drives editing; a legacy `edit` view is ignored.
